Tushar Deshpande Takes Hat-trick in Ranji Trophy Match

In a Ranji Trophy match, Tushar Deshpande took a hat-trick and claimed multiple wickets, leading to Chandigarh being bowled out for 78 runs. Mumbai, the team Deshpande plays for, enforced the follow-on against Chandigarh. Deshpande's performance was noted as historic for Mumbai.
